case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels). Need: 23700 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 14 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200018. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.body:
Dear Franz Seidl,

thank you for your offer and for the reliable cooperation. We would like to settle this in a way that works for both sides. move.text:
Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
A few words on this from our side.
We appreciate your commitment to a 24-month contract, which provides mutual planning security.
However, due to the volatility of raw materials, we cannot offer a fixed price over such a long period and must include an AS-14404 index clause.
With this necessary adjustment to the terms, we can offer a revised price of €5.60 per unit.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. We always strive to support your business with our broad range of high-quality materials and reliable distribution service.

Following our analysis, our offer stands at a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

The rate of €5.40 per unit is the most competitive price we can provide for a 24-month agreement with 30-day payment terms. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Therefore, we must present this as our final offer for these terms. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
